_comment: The declared local layer. `import_hyperos_rules.py` merges this into embedding_config.json
AFTER the 3.01.48 conversion and records every step in hyperos_import_audit.json.
It exists because a re-import must not be able to silently delete a hand-verified rule
again -- which is exactly what happened to com.sina.weibo when the corpus was swapped in.
Schema and semantics: README.md in this directory.

_why: Lenovo's own corpus for this tablet has 288 packages; 211 of them are also in 3.01.48 and
keep that conversion. These 77 are in NO other source. They are first-party rules written
by this device's OEM for this device, in the schema this port already parses.
None of them is installed here, so like the other 6,968 rows they express upstream intent
rather than per-version device proof -- with the single exception of com.sina.weibo, which
is overridden below by a row measured on the installed APK.

packages._source: hand-authored from Lenovo's own row, corrected against the installed APK
_why: ★ Weibo is the one package in this corpus with a measured rule rather than a declared one.
No Xiaomi-derived corpus adapts it: the 3.01.48 row for com.sina.weibo is
fullRule="nra:cr:rcr:nr:uc", i.e. Xiaomi's fullscreen/orientation engine, not Activity
Embedding, so the importer excludes it (see excludedFullRulePackages in the audit, and
the row is not a duplicate -- com.sina.weibo appears exactly once in all 8,046 source
rows). Lenovo's own corpus DOES adapt it, and that row is the skeleton of this one.
Four departures from Lenovo's row, each measured on APK 16.8.0 / versionCode 8105:
1. Four classes Lenovo names do not exist in this APK and are dropped:
photoalbum.imageviewer.ImageViewer, video.tabcontainer.VideoTabContainerActivity,
MediaCoreActivity (all three pair targets) and InterceptActivity (a trampoline).
2. Lenovo enumerates seven concrete targets for VisitorMainTabActivity. That enumeration
is stale in the direction that matters: tapping a post opens
feed.detailrefactor.DetailPageActivity, which is in NO vendor list, and tapping media
opens story.multiv2.core.MediaCoreV2Activity, which replaced MediaCoreActivity. The
wildcard is what Lenovo already uses for MainTabActivity, so this makes the two main
pages symmetric rather than inventing anything.
3. Both main pages are trampolines in the 'never a secondary' sense. Lenovo got this for
free by enumerating; widening to the wildcard means saying it. Without it, logging in
from the visitor page would route the whole logged-in main page into the right pane.
The engine centres them anyway -- a trampoline a rule also calls a split source is not
a trampoline, see SystemMiddlePolicy.
4. Composer, QR scanner, in-app browser and the mini-program host move from Lenovo's
transActivities to forceFullscreenPages. Lenovo's schema has ONE list for 'never
occupies a pane' because its engine has no centred presentation; ours has two, and
these four are full-task PAGES rather than trampolines. forceFullscreenPages is the
better mechanism for a page you come back from: alwaysExpand gives it its own
task-sized fragment, so the split underneath survives and is still there when it
finishes. transActivities would have mutated the container the user was already in.
Measured on hardware, logged out, 2026-08-12 (each verdict from `dumpsys activity
containers` with the pair decision from `log.tag.ParallelWindow DEBUG`):
cold launch      VisitorMainTabActivity        centred [876,0][2628,2190] = 876x1095dp
tap a post       feed.detailrefactor.DetailPageActivity      secondary pane
back             VisitorMainTabActivity        re-centred [876,0][2628,2190]
tap media        story.multiv2.core.MediaCoreV2Activity      secondary pane
search box       search.middle.SearchMiddleActivity          secondary pane
author name      search.searchv3.SearchActivityV2            secondary pane
hashtag          feed.detailrefactor.DetailPageActivity      secondary pane
Message / Me / + account.login.LoginActivity                 secondary pane
Video / Discover (same activity, internal tab)               stays centred
★ The immersive media viewer was going to be added to forceFullscreenPages until it was
looked at: in the secondary pane it renders a full vertical-video player with the
timeline still live beside it, which is the best thing this feature does. Lenovo routed
it to the pane too. Measurement changed the rule.
NOT measured, because the device has no Weibo account: everything reachable only when
logged in -- MainTabActivity as a pair source, the composer, private messages, the
profile page. Those entries are written symmetrically with the visitor ones and are
declared, not proven. The in-app browser and QR scanner were likewise never triggered.
Presentation values are materialized rather than left to the parser, because the
parser's own fallbacks are the LEGACY five-rule ones (0.35 / 840 / 600 / FINISH_ALWAYS /
middle=false) and a row that omitted them would silently differ from every other row in
the file.
packages.name: com.sina.weibo
